pain_point: Commute and location concerns - I need something close to the freeway and port — Truganina ticks that box but is it too far west?
primary_text: "I need something close to the freeway and port." You need logistics efficiency, not a CBD postcode. Truganina is Melbourne's fastest-growing industrial precinct because the numbers make sense. Princes Freeway on your doorstep. West Gate Tunnel slashing commute times. Port of Melbourne a short drive south. Major retailers, logistics firms, and manufacturers have already moved west — and land values reflect the momentum. These off-the-plan warehouses let you own premium industrial space at a fraction of inner-suburb pricing. Your freight doesn't care about postcodes. Your bottom line shouldn't either.
description: Located in Melbourne's highest-growth industrial corridor with major freeway access
